messages:
mike: Noticed a spike in 401s for SSO to billing-service post-deploy. Users report getting sent back to Okta with an error.

security-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-SAML created by mike.

anya: Which error code from our SP logs? I see `saml.validate: audience_mismatch` for a lot of assertions.

mike: Root SAML assertion shows Audience `https://billing.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata` but our deployed SP expects `https://billing-prod.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata`.

carl: We renamed the prod host in terraform last week. The deploy pipeline used env SAML_AUDIENCE=`https://billing-prod.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata` but the Okta app was updated to the short host without -prod.

jen: Also seeing SCIM provision records failing with 403 from KMS when trying to decrypt service token: `InvalidCiphertextException`. RBAC commit earlier replaced service principal `svc/sso-writes` with `svc/sso-writer` and I think the IAM role ARN in the KMS key policy didn't get updated.

anya: Two simultaneous issues then: SP metadata/audience mismatch and KMS decrypt permission removed. Both would break SSO and SCIM.

mike: Triage steps: 1) add a temporary audience alias in SP config to accept both values, 2) update Okta app metadata to match canonical SAML_AUDIENCE, 3) patch KMS key policy to re-add kms:Decrypt to new role, 4) run SCIM reconcile.

infra-bot: Apply request queued: terraform plan for okta-saml-app update (PR #401)

carl: I'm rolling a hotfix to accept the alternate audience on the SP side: added regex-based audience check in sso proxy so we don't block sessions while Okta is fixed. Pushed and rolled out.

jen: Patching KMS key policy now. Command: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd --policy file://pol.json` patched to include `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-sso-writer` with Decrypt.

mike: After KMS patch, SCIM write attempts show `INFO scim: provision ok user=jdoe` in logs.

anya: Okta metadata updated to canonical SAML_AUDIENCE and ACS URL. Verified fingerprint and certs match.

mike: Smoke test: login via Okta -> redirected -> SAML assertion accepted -> session created. Verified.

security-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-SAML status: mitigated -> monitoring.

carl: Follow-ups: 1) add deployment gate that verifies Okta SAML app properties match deployed SAML env vars, 2) RBAC change checklist to update KMS key policies when role names change, 3) add SSO end-to-end smoke job post-release.

jen: I'll own the KMS RBAC checklist item and open PR to automate policy updates in infra repo.

mike: Adding audit log query to incident: `event:type in (session:create, scim:provision, kms:decrypt)` and archiving results for compliance.

anya: All good on my end, monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
